capability_statement: AOF can package its next-task judgment so a first-time or external operator can replay the reasoning path and make a Go/No-Go decision within five minutes.
before_state: The operator had to ask the AI to translate internal candidate task labels and infer what AOF was actually asking them to approve.
after_state: AOF records the situation, candidate tasks, selected task, evidence path, reproduction steps, comprehension checks, Go/No-Go, and next human action in one bounded artifact.
scenario: Ask AOF what the next most important task is; inspect the v11.1 reproduction packet and confirm whether the reasoning can be replayed without reading the whole repo.
five_minute_demo: Open TASK-132-external-operator-reproduction.json and follow the five reproduction steps, then run external-operator-reproduction-audit to verify the packet is complete.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Removes repeated clarification cycles where the operator asks what the English task names mean and why the selected task matters.
cognitive_load_removed: The operator no longer needs to decode internal release labels, search for evidence manually, or guess whether Go/No-Go is being requested.

capability_matrix.before: internal next-task judgment needed AI translation
capability_matrix.after: bounded Japanese reproduction packet supports five-minute Go/No-Go
capability_matrix.user_value: operator can understand the current task decision and next action without repository-wide reading

not_proven: This does not prove actual third-party adoption, market value, semantic truth, productivity gain, or broad UX quality.
